# Paste-ready itch.io copy for 0.21.0-beta1

Use this copy only after the exact committed candidate and Windows package are
verified and publication is approved. Replace the ZIP and checksum together.

## ProjektKraken 0.21.0 beta 1

Connect Event dates so one follows another, review the resulting changes, and
trace dependencies on the Timeline. Map feature and group presence can follow
Event boundaries too, including their recorded uncertainty.

Activity workspaces keep arrangements for writing, chronology, maps, connections
and research. A searchable Settings Center brings configuration together.
Historical World Context shows saved connections and description changes with
their dates and sources, with more direct connections available to browse.

This release upgrades worlds to schema 4. **Back up complete world folders
before updating and retain the upgrade recovery bundle. Older versions cannot
open upgraded worlds.** Keep a pre-upgrade copy if you need to return to the
previous application.

## Download and install

Download `ProjektKraken-0.21.0-beta1-windows-x64.zip` and
`ProjektKraken-0.21.0-beta1-windows-x64.zip.sha256`. In PowerShell, run:

```powershell
Get-FileHash .\ProjektKraken-0.21.0-beta1-windows-x64.zip -Algorithm SHA256
```

Compare the reported hash with the checksum file. Extract the complete ZIP into
an ordinary user folder and run `ProjektKraken\ProjektKraken.exe`. Keep
`_internal` beside the executable. Python is not required. The application is
unsigned, so Windows may ask you to confirm that you want to run it.

Install the complete new application folder when updating; replacing only the
executable is insufficient.

## Known limitations

- The packaged beta is for Windows x64.
- Rich wiki editing covers paragraphs, headings 1–3, bold, italic and wiki links.
  Other Markdown remains editable in exact Source view.
- Wiki Peek displays text descriptions without rich media previews.
- Dated map path and region shapes switch at the authored date without morphing.
- Relation vocabulary and forward/reverse wording remain follow-up work.
- Broken or unresolved timing references need explicit review; resolve references
  before deleting their source Event or removing a referenced end.

See the [release notes](https://github.com/cmintert/ProjektKraken/blob/main/docs/releases/0.21.0-beta1.md)
for the complete upgrade guidance. Report issues with your Windows version,
package version and reproduction steps.
